summary: Lincoln County, New Mexico, tower that the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists as gone; no history source found.

evidence.supports: Tucson Mtn in Lincoln County, at the record's coordinates, a tower, marked gone

notes_for_editor: Only one source says anything about this tower: the FFLA New Mexico list gives name, county, coordinates, type (Tower) and status (Gone), with no register number. Two web searches, the FFLA Lincoln County list and a Wikipedia lookup (404) gave no builder, date, staffing, fate or site description. The story is far below the 120-word floor because the evidence is thin, and it is not padded. Leads to try: Lincoln National Forest (Smokey Bear Ranger District) history, New Mexico Forestry Division records, Ruidoso and Capitan newspapers, and the USFS Lincoln NF recreation pages. Check the coordinates against a map before publishing.
